claims.text: The patch caused the positive share of reviews to drop by 11.53 points at horizon 7 days. Reviews came in a burst during this window; on such windows the method raised false alarms at most 10% of the time in its benchmark. The game's discounts weren't tracked at the time, so a price change can't be ruled out.
Monetization negative mentions increased by 9.89 points of share in the window compared to the baseline.
Platform policy negative mentions increased by 4.00 points of share in the window.
Players expressed major frustration over the new permanent price reduction and Gold Edition bundle structure.
Off-topic negative review share changed by -0.14 percentage points, showing no evidence of a review bomb.
Reviewers with over 200 hours of playtime made up 16.42% of the window reviews compared to 10.55% in the baseline.

report.summary: The patch caused the positive share of reviews to drop by 11.53 points at horizon 7 days. Monetization negative mentions increased by 9.89 points of share in the window compared to the baseline, and platform policy negative mentions increased by 4.00 points of share. Players expressed major frustration over the new permanent price reduction and Gold Edition bundle structure. Off-topic negative review share changed by -0.14 percentage points, and reviewers with over 200 hours of playtime made up 16.42% of the window reviews compared to 10.55% in the baseline. The patch is supported. A price change or sale, off-topic reviews or a review bomb, and a change in who reviewed are inconclusive. Noise or seasonality is rejected.
